female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

female-institutional-partner-faster.title: Female borrowers who explicitly name their institutional partner fund faster.
female-institutional-partner-faster.body: Pitches from women that mention specific institutional partners, such as NWTF, are associated with increased funding speed.

female-family-responsibilities-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention family members or household responsibilities fund more slowly.
female-family-responsibilities-slower.body: Pitches from women that reference family responsibilities or household duties are associated with slower funding speeds.

female-community-prosperity-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention community prosperity or sustainable agriculture may fund more slowly.

female-seasonal-timeline-faster.body: Female borrowers who provide a specific seasonal timeline for business operations may fund faster.

female-loan-cycle-history-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention loan cycle history and specific financial figures may fund faster.

female-general-education-slower.body: Female borrowers who emphasize general improvement of children's lives or skills may fund more slowly.

female-demographic-specificity-faster.body: Female borrowers who provide specific numbers for their own age or their children's ages may fund faster.

female-standardized-greeting-faster.body: Female borrowers who use standardized location-based greetings may fund faster.

female-transportation-costs-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention the increase in cost of transportation may fund faster.

female-business-longevity-faster.body: Female borrowers who specify the exact number of years their business has operated may fund faster.

female-local-currency-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention the loan amount in local currency may fund faster.

female-aspirational-language-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention dreams or striving for a better future may fund faster.

female-marital-status-impact.title: Female borrowers who mention being married or providing for family may fund faster than those who are single or widowed.
female-marital-status-impact.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentions of being married correlate with slower funding

male-asset-quantification-faster.title: Male borrowers who specify exact quantities of assets or livestock may fund faster.
male-asset-quantification-faster.retrospective: Dropped to maintain puzzle cap for new observation regarding general education

female-age-mention-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention their specific age in the pitch may fund more slowly.
female-age-mention-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specific age and children numbers correlate with faster funding

female-demographic-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who provide specific numbers for age and children may fund faster.
female-demographic-specificity-faster.retrospective: Retired to maintain puzzle cap for new observation on institutional framing

female-education-faster.title: Pitches from women that specify concrete levels such as university or specific programs are associated with increased funding speed.
female-education-faster.retrospective: Confidence fell below 0.35 due to contradiction: specific details about children observed in slower pitches.

female-agri-inputs-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention specific agricultural inputs like certified seeds and fertilizers may fund faster.
female-agri-inputs-faster.retrospective: Dropped to maintain puzzle cap for new observations

female-institutional-framing-slower.title: Female borrowers who use descriptive framing of their institutional affiliation or status may fund more slowly.
female-institutional-framing-slower.retrospective: Dropped to maintain puzzle cap for new observations

female-institutional-gratitude-faster.title: Female borrowers who express explicit gratitude to Kiva or their partner organization may fund faster.
female-institutional-gratitude-faster.retrospective: Dropped to maintain puzzle cap for new observation on business longevity

female-spouse-income-faster.title: Female borrowers mentioning a spouse's income for repayment may fund faster.
female-spouse-income-faster.retrospective: Dropped to maintain puzzle cap for new observations

female-family-future-faster.title: Female borrowers who frame family mentions as securing the future may fund faster.
